Package com.eventlottery.model

Class EventTemp

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.EventTemp
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class EventTemp extends Object implements android.os.Parcelable
Event data model representing an event in the lottery system This class represents all properties and methods for an Event in the system. It includes geolocation validation, waitlist management, and lottery functionality.
